description: Ministry of Regional Development - Order to Amend the Gaz. Ex. No. 302/12 of 01.02.1978, published under the State Agricultural  Corporations Act
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment of an existing legal order (The State Agricultural Corporations Act, No.11 of 1972) through statutory instruments. It contains specific legal modifications to schedules and paragraphs, defines legal terms ("agro-industry," "commercial farming"), and represents regulatory changes to agricultural corporate governance. While it mentions a minister's name, this is in the context of exercising statutory authority to make regulatory changes, not about government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette rather than a government classification type.
